name: baseline-smoke
description: Curated high-value smoke and first golden-baseline set: all 10 categories, every task shape, EN and SR, high-impact domains, provenance- and adversarial-heavy prompts, and prompts whose routing was affected by the matcher fixes. Run dry by default: npm run eval:baseline-smoke. Live: npm run eval:baseline-smoke -- --live --model=<m> --judge-model=<m> --confirm-calls=<planned>.

entries.rationale: Mandatory high-impact security audit. Exercises the application-security and api-backend semantic groups, the injection canary on an attacker-minded prompt and claim-level provenance for vulnerability findings.
Serbian twin of the security audit. Confirms the SR prompt keeps the same trust-boundary behavior and does not become weaker or broader in translation.
Mandatory legal research audit. Provenance is the core risk (citation laundering, secondary sources presented as authority, missing jurisdiction), so provenance and missing-context are both tested.
Serbian twin of the legal research audit to check that source-status and authority discipline survive translation.

Mandatory medication reconciliation audit in Serbian: the exact prompt where 'api' matched inside 'terapije'. Checks medication-safety rules, no unilateral dose advice, escalation and missing medication-list handling.
English twin of medication reconciliation for EN/SR parity on the highest-consequence boundary and missing-context behavior.
Mandatory causal question and DAG builder. Tests the causal-inference group (estimand, confounders vs colliders, identification assumptions) on a builder-shaped task.
Serbian twin of the DAG builder; routing now comes from the English title only, so the SR prompt must show the same causal rules.
Structured-output generator whose primary shape changed from builder to generator with the head-noun rule. Regression fixture checks reproducibility metadata for application-integrated output.
The only IT red-team prompt. Adversarial content is the subject matter here, so it tests that the model analyzes attacks without obeying the injected instruction.
Valuation is one of only two forecast-shaped business prompts. Checks units, currency, period and assumption sensitivity, and refusal to invent missing financial inputs.
Business strategy stress test (red-team) to check that boundary conditions produce counterexamples and stop conditions rather than generic risks.
Conflicting-authority resolver: previously received security rules because 'authority' matched 'auth'. Now a decision shape; tests hierarchy of authority and conflict handling.
Data breach legal response is a high-impact generator with privacy obligations and deadlines; checks that generated notices do not invent facts or follow injected instructions.
Urgent vs routine care navigation: the red-flag and safety-netting behavior must hold on boundary symptoms and when key history is missing.
Certainty-of-evidence grading is a research-shaped prompt where directness, study design and source status decide the answer.
Self-testing question generator: an education generator where the learning-science group applies and output must be directly usable.
Tutoring progress monitor is one of the few tracker-shaped prompts; checks source of truth, cadence and stale or missing data handling.
Heterogeneity and synthesis analyzer exercises the meta-analysis group and the analysis shape; pooling decisions are a classic boundary failure.
Career option decision matrix is the only career decision-shaped prompt; checks explicit criteria, trade-offs and sensitivity in Serbian.
Resume audit where fabrication of metrics or seniority is the main risk; tests refusal to invent achievements when evidence is missing.
Conversion copy red team: claim substantiation and deceptive-persuasion checks, with provenance for performance claims.
Marketing experiment backlog: kept as a tracker only because 'backlog' is now an explicit tracker term after the substring 'log' was removed.
Project status report is a structured tracker output; status must surface decisions and blockers and handle missing status data explicitly.
Resource conflict resolution previously had task-shape rules only through the false match 'resource' -> 'source'; now routed as decision via 'resolution'.
Lighting plan builder in Serbian: 'osvetljenja' used to match 'etl' and inject data-engineering rules into a photography prompt.
Identity system red team covers the creative domain's red-team shape and rights or provenance pressure on brand assets.
